name: Iron phosphorus trisulfide
equilibrium_context: Van der Waals antiferromagnet, Neel temperature 118 K, Ising-like, no net magnetization
summary: The longest lifetime of a driven magnetic state in the registry: more than 2.5 milliseconds.

driven_states.emergent_property: Intense THz pulses generate a metastable net magnetization with a lifetime of more than 2.5 milliseconds. Nonlinear excitation of a phonon mode displaces a Raman mode whose displacement modulates the exchange couplings such that a ground state with finite magnetization is favoured.
driven_states.source: Ilyas, Luo, von Hoegen et al., Nature 636, 609 (2024), doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08226-x
driven_states.caveat: So far one group, one material. The millisecond lifetime substantially exceeds the measurement window of conventional pump-probe technique and rests on a repetition-rate analyzis. The interpretation as a new magnetic ground state relies essentially on the accompanying calculation, not on a direct structural determination.

threshold.quantity: strongly nonlinear field dependence; amplitude and lifetime both grow on approaching the Neel temperature
